title: Quasi-separatedness from affine-open intersections
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. (1) If $X$ is quasi-separated, meaning that $X\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ has quasi-compact diagonal [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], then the intersection of any two affine open subschemes of $X$ is quasi-compact. (2) Conversely, if $X$ has an open covering $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ by affine open subschemes such that $U_i\cap U_j$ is quasi-compact for every $i,j\in I$, then $X$ is quasi-separated.
